title: Electric foot scooters; registration.

bodyHtml:
[§249-35]  Electric foot scooters; registration.  An electric foot scooter shall be required to be registered, and shall be subject to a permanent registration fee of $30, to be paid by the owners thereof to the director of finance to be deposited into the bikeway fund under section 249-17.5, Hawaii Revised Statutes. [L 2021, c 174, §1]
